Contract ManageUserCRUDService::createUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		newUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = userid),
		userExists: Boolean = User.allInstance()->includes(userid)
	precondition:
		userid.oclIsUndefined() = bool or
		User.allInstance()->includes(userid) = bool
	postcondition:
		let newUser: User in
		newUser.oclIsNew() and
		User.allInstance()->includes(newUser) and
		result = true
}
